nodes.description: Private uint256 state variable holding the random secret number that must be guessed.
Public uint256 state variable recording the timestamp of the last play.
Public address state variable holding the contract owner.
Constant address state variable receiving 20% of the balance on kill().
Array state variable storing Player structs (addr, ethr) for every guess.
Constructor that sets owner = msg.sender and calls shuffle().
Public payable function accepting a guess number, recording the player and paying out if correct.
Internal function generating a pseudo-random secretNumber from block.timestamp and msg.sender.
Public function allowing the owner to drain the balance to megaman and owner.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership, randomness, player recording and payouts.
Block timestamp (now/block.timestamp) used for randomness and lastPlayed.
External value transfer of the contract balance to the caller-controlled msg.sender.
External value transfer of 20% of the balance to the megaman address.
External value transfer of 80% of the balance to the owner address.
Arithmetic expression (balance*20)/100 used to compute the megaman payout share.
uint256 parameter of guess() representing the player's guess between 0 and 10.
Local Player struct populated with msg.sender and msg.value before being pushed.
Local uint256 caching address(this).balance inside kill().

edges.reason: Constructor assigns the untrusted msg.sender as the owner, granting privileged access to kill().
Constructor invokes shuffle() to initialize secretNumber.
number is the input parameter of guess().
guess() writes lastPlayed from the timestamp now, creating timestamp dependency.
guess() updates lastPlayed with now.
guess() compares number against secretNumber.
The parameter number is compared to the secretNumber state variable.
guess() uses msg.sender to identify the player and perform the payout.
player.addr is set to msg.sender.
guess() pushes the populated player struct into players.
guess() transfers the entire contract balance to the caller via msg.sender.transfer.
The external transfer sends value to the untrusted msg.sender, enabling a reentrant callback.
msg.sender.transfer can re-enter guess() while state is not finalized.
guess() calls shuffle() after processing the guess.
shuffle() derives secretNumber from block.timestamp, a miner-influenceable value.
shuffle() uses msg.sender as randomness entropy, which is caller-controlled.
shuffle() writes the computed value into secretNumber.
kill() validates the caller against owner using msg.sender.
kill() requires msg.sender == owner before draining funds.
kill() caches address(this).balance in the local balance variable.
kill() performs an external transfer to megaman.
kill() performs an external transfer to owner.
megaman.transfer sends value to the megaman constant address.
owner.transfer sends value to the owner address.
balance is used in the arithmetic (balance*20)/100 computation.
The (balance*20)/100 result feeds the megaman.transfer amount.

normalization_plan.reason: number is only the input parameter of guess() and can be folded into the guess function node.
player is a transient local struct built and pushed exclusively inside guess().
balance is a transient local cache of address(this).balance used only inside kill().
